template_data.headline_html: Five SAM.gov mistakes that freeze your contracts.

items.title: Missing the renewal window
items.sub: SAM expires annually — set reminders 60 days out, not 10

items.title: Wrong or missing NAICS codes
items.sub: Agencies search by NAICS — if you're unlisted, you don't exist

items.title: Stale reps and certifications
items.sub: Revenue, headcount, certs must reflect your current reality

items.title: Outdated banking information
items.sub: Wrong EFT details freeze payments regardless of award status

items.title: No account monitoring
items.sub: SAM fraud is real — review your record quarterly and set login alerts
